heading: Input errors
text:
## Input errors [NERR.5]

| Code | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `DS_ERR_PARSE`               | a DSC atom body, or `ds_json_parse` input, is malformed; JSON text in which one object repeats a key is malformed ([LGRA.5.8.7]), and so is JSON text holding an integer literal outside the 64-bit signed range ([LGRA.5.8.9]) or a float literal past the largest finite `Float` ([LGRA.5.8.10]) |
| `DS_ERR_SCHEMA_UNKNOWN`      | an action referenced a schema that isn't registered; or a replayed `FactAssert` names a schema the stream never announced or the engine does not hold ([RFCS.5.4]) |
| `DS_ERR_SLOT_UNKNOWN`        | a referenced slot is not on the schema |
| `DS_ERR_SLOT_TYPE_MISMATCH`  | a slot value's `kind` ≠ the schema's declared type (assert path), or a fact-ref whose schema ≠ the slot's `schema_ref` |

-102 and -105 to -108 are reserved and never reused ([IERR.2.4]).
